title: Real mountains round the Crown and the Red Badlands
changes: The Crown of the Marches is now ringed by tall 3D granite mountains with snow on their peaks, instead of flat cliff walls.
The Red Badlands are walled by stepped 3D red rock: broad ledges and sheer banded cliffs, lit and shadowed by the sun.
The roads between the lands still pass through, in gaps between the mountains.
